lines.t: Verse 1
In quiet moments, I hear You call my name,
Softly leading me, helping me through every pain.
When I feel lost, You guide my way
Helping me walk through every day.
So I give You my heart, I give my love to You,
So Lord, help make me new.
Chorus
Lord, I'll take your hand,
Let You lead me in what is true.
Clean my heart and make it new.
I want to walk with You all my days,
I’ll follow You all the way.
Verse 2
When I am weak, You make me strong.
When I am falling, You help me along.
You are my hope when skies are grey,
You're the love my heart feels every day.
Chorus
Lord, I'll take your hand,
Let You lead me in what is true.
Clean my heart and make it new.
I want to walk with You all my days,
I’ll follow You all the way.
Bridge
Lift my heart, hold it in Your hands.
Hold me in Your arms, don't let go.
Wrap me in the love I have always known.
Final
Oh, Lord. I am Your daughter,
My heart is Yours.
Take all I am and make me whole.
For all eternity, with You I'll stay.
I'll follow You all the way.
